free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed seed so the run is deterministic (T6/D8).

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: The repository stores KV caches in fp16 (TorchDevice.init_cache_one_gpu_batch uses np.float16).

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: Smallest head count; the target condition reads only the device type and whether the first segment exists.

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: Smallest positive head dimension; the target decision does not read the last dimension.

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: Smallest batch; the target decision does not read the batch size.

free_parameters.name: seq_len
free_parameters.why: Small sequence length; the target decision only reads device type and segment presence, not the sequence length.

free_parameters.name: cache_gpu_percent
free_parameters.why: A mixed placement value; the cache tensor is allocated explicitly from gpu_segments, so this only documents the policy.

free_parameters.name: cache_cpu_percent
free_parameters.why: The rest of the mixed placement; the cache tensor is allocated explicitly from gpu_segments.

execution.entry_reason: Static analysis found no call chain from TorchDevice.mha to SelfAttention.prefetch_cache; TorchDevice.mha never calls prefetch_cache. The finding's own witness says call_chain_status=not_found, so the target function is called directly with the state (cache_home with a mixed-device k_home) the checked call expects.
